metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: This question is about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in three Chinese cities during specific time periods in early 2020. I need to: 1. Use appropriate data source for NO2 - likely Sentinel-5P TROPOMI which has NO2 data 2. Define geometries for Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan 3. Compare two time periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 vs Jan 1-20, 2020 4. Check if ALL three cities show decrease in mean NO2 levels Strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 collection - Create polygons for the three cities - Calculate mean NO2 for each city in each time period - Compare the values to see if all decreased Data quality considerations: - Check if collections have data for both periods - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate the NO2 values are reasonable (not NaN, within expected range) Output should determine if ALL three cities show decrease. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry Definitions for the three cities const beijing = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([116.0, 39.5, 117.0, 40.5]); const chongqing = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([106.0, 29.0, 107.0, 30.0]); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([114.0, 30.3, 114.7, 31.0]); const cities = { 'Beijing': beijing, 'Chongqing': chongqing, 'Wuhan': wuhan }; // 2. Time periods const period1 = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; // Jan 1-20 const period2 = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // Feb 10-25 // 3. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P NO2 const no2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2'); function getNO2Mean(cityGeom, startDate, endDate) { const col = no2Col .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cityGeom) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const count = col.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) return null; const meanImg = col.mean(); const stats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: cityGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanVal = stats.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const pixelCount = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cityGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); return {mean: meanVal, pixels: pixelCount, images: count}; } // 4. Process all cities and periods let allDecreased = true; let hasData = true; for (const [cityName, geometry] of Object.entries(cities)) { const period1Data = getNO2Mean(geometry, period1[0], period1[1]); const period2Data = getNO2Mean(geometry, period2[0], period2[1]); if (!period1Data || !period2Data) { console.log(`${cityName}: Missing data for one or both periods`); hasData = false; continue; } if (period1Data.pixels === 0 || period2Data.pixels === 0) { console.log(`${cityName}: No valid pixels`); hasData = false; continue; } const change = ((period2Data.mean - period1Data.mean) / period1Data.mean * 100); console.log(`${cityName}: Jan=${period1Data.mean.toFixed(4)}, Feb=${period2Data.mean.toFixed(4)}, Change=${change.toFixed(1)}%`); if (period2Data.mean >= period1Data.mean) { allDecreased = false; } } // 5. Final determination if (!hasData) { console.log("C1"); } else if (allDecreased) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
